component.name: OpenSmash Ultimate
component.summary: Build and play Super Smash Bros. Ultimate from your own dump

description.p: OpenSmash Ultimate is a native PC port of Super Smash Bros. Ultimate made by static recompilation. The game's AArch64 code is translated to C and compiled for your PC on first install, from your own legally obtained dump.

This package contains the project's toolchain and runtime only: no game code, assets, keys or firmware. Choose your base game and update packages (or an existing dump), your prod.keys and optionally DLC packages; the app creates the dump, builds the game and starts it.
The first build takes about 1.5 to 2.5 hours and needs about 30 GB of free disk space. The build can be stopped and continued. Saves live in the app's data folder.
